svg.aria-label: TQPNet: self-supervised offline training and residual-checked online ADMM refinement
svg.title: TQPNet — SOLARIS graphical abstract
svg.desc: Projected parameter samples train a neural primal–dual warm start through K derived ADMM–ReLU layers and a log-scaled KKT residual loss. Online, only batch instances above the residual tolerance receive extra iterations and are rechecked. Motion is generated from a separate illustrative two-dimensional problem, not reported paper results.
